title: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Job
description: Schema for a job execution record in the Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, representing a single run of a job template including its status, timing, and output metadata.

id.description: The unique numeric identifier of the job execution.

name.description: The name of the job, typically inherited from the job template.

status.description: The current execution status of the job.

failed.description: Whether the job execution resulted in a failure.

started.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when job execution began.

finished.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when job execution completed.

elapsed.description: The elapsed wall-clock time in seconds for the job execution.

job_type.description: The type of job that was executed.

job_template.description: The ID of the job template that was executed.

inventory.description: The ID of the inventory targeted by this job.

project.description: The ID of the project containing the playbook.

playbook.description: The playbook filename that was executed.

forks.description: The number of parallel processes used for execution.

limit.description: The host pattern used to limit the inventory scope.

verbosity.description: The verbosity level of the job output (0=normal, 5=maximum debug).

extra_vars.description: Extra variables passed to the playbook in YAML or JSON format.

artifacts.description: Artifacts collected during job execution, such as set_stats data.

host_status_counts.description: Summary counts of host statuses from job execution.

ok.description: Hosts that completed successfully with no changes.

created.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the job record was created.

modified.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the job record was last modified.

JobTemplate.description: A job template defining the parameters for running an Ansible playbook.

id.description: The unique identifier of the job template.

name.description: The name of the job template.

description.description: A description of the job template.
